name: Kanban Board
description: Organise anything in columns: drag cards from To do to Done, with colours and quick editing.
prompt: A Kanban board with To do, Doing, Review and Done columns, colourful cards I can drag between columns and reorder, swipe between columns, and tap a card to edit, move or delete it.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Organiza lo que sea en columnas: arrastra tarjetas de Por hacer a Hecho, con colores y edición rápida.
